QuestInfo.name: The Lost Saddle
QuestInfo.0: You lost the Dragon Saddle! What to do? Go to #b#p2060005##k in the #b#m230000000# #m230000003##k and ask for another saddle.
QuestInfo.1: #p2060005# says that he will make you a saddle if you bring him #b50 #t4000155#s#k and #b1 #t4032474##k like before. However, unlike last time, he won't give you a special discount and will charge the full #b20 million mesos#k. Bring him all the materials.\n\nYou can obtain the materials by entering the door of the Mushroom House between the Ribbon Pigs upstairs.
QuestInfo.2: You received the saddle from #p2060005# again. It's not cheap so you should be careful not to lose it again.

0.0: Oh, you're the person who wanted to mount that strange animal. What brings you back? Did you lose the saddle?

1.0: You've brought all the materials! And the fee as well! Hehe, I'll go ahead and start making your saddle. I should be able to make it much faster this time.

yes.0: Here is the completed saddle. Enjoy it and feel free to come back if you happen to lose it. See you next time!

item.0:
You still haven't gathered all the materials?
I will make you a Dragon Saddle if you bring me #b50 pieces of #t4000592#s#k, #b1 #t4032474##k, and a #bspecial discounted fee of 20 million Mesos#k.

You can get the materials by going up a floor, and then going into the Orange Mushroom house between the Pig Ribbons.
